text: あたしも　つよく　なりたいの　コツを　おしえて　くれない　かしら

structure.jp: あたしも　つよく　なりたいの
structure.en: I want to get stronger too

structure.jp: コツを　おしえて　くれない　かしら
structure.en: I wonder if you'd teach me the trick

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: おしえて　くれない
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くれる means someone does it as a favor for the speaker, and asking with くれない is a gentle request. おしえて　くれない = 'won't you teach me?'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word ending in く plus なる means 'to become' that way. つよく　なりたい = 'want to become strong'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do' it. なりたい = 'want to become'.
